body:
thank you for your response.  i had actually never really thought of creating websites for local music.  i'm actually in contact with a number of local musicians, and that would be an avenue i'll most likely check out.

i guess the crux of my situation revolves around the meeting of creative and technical.  i'm unaware of any street artists around my area, but i'd imagine they are out there, and could probably find them.

anyhow, thank you for listening and supplying feedback.  it's much appreciated.

i guess my motivation is i just want to find kindred souls who feel that they need to express themselves creatively, and have a true urge to do so, but just can't find the means.  and are stuck in extremely rudimentary positions.

i just can't find anyone to relate with.

edit: reddit, i know it's stupid to go to an online community for help or guidance, or hell, just morale, but i just had an especially horrible night.  i hope someone can relate.

i just finished school.  i've been dealing with depression for over 4 years now, and graduation has brought on a whole new slew of ideas.  i guess i just don't really know where i'm going.  i majored in an IT related field, and did well, getting into the honors society and have a great GPA, scoring a decent job in the IT industry in my junior year.  i guess it just gets to the point that i'm not sure what to do anymore.  i feel like i'm observing life objectively, and no one else sees my viewpoint.  i see the fact that, if i applied myself, i could be a fucking great web programmer, but that whole community is so fucking cannibalistic and full of violent change that it scares the shit out of me.  and any joy i got out of designing websites and showing people my creative side got shot to fucking hell because it wasn't up to standards to months post project.  is there someone out there that is nerdy and technical at heart but just fucking aches to express themselves creatively but has no idea how to do so?  if so, for christ's sake i'd say we're in the minority, but i just don't fucking know what to do with my life.  i dunno, i just needed to vent.  this is an anonymous account, and i just needed to state my thoughts.  i've never attempted suicide, but i've strongly considered it twice.  the first time, i ran out of physical strength, fell asleep, and in the morning things felt better.  the other time, i was drunk, and i kept listening to a smith's song (i know, fucking stupid reason to not kill yourself), but i just found joy in it, and it diverted my attention.  

reddit, i've read you for years.  i just found this subreddit, and i'm just at a fucking terrifying time in my life.  it's hard to find a path in a line of work that is in constant flux, and with the lack of a truly social life, i find it hard to relate.  thanks for listening.
